currentRoundInspection.method: Reference picture pixels inspected; standard viewer PMTiles used for approximate location, orientation and terrain fit.
currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected aerial picture supports the crenellated fortress with rectangular towers, open courts, roofed north towers and long walled hillside stair to the lower tower. Retained map controls set approximate plan scale and heading0. Standard viewer PMTiles supply the hill. The main court is reconstructed8m above the anchor datum; bounded outer wall and museum footings reach sampled terrain. The lower tower preserves its13m exterior height on its own PMTiles floor; its stair and walled link meet that tower and the main wall walk. Anchor -9.133459014,38.713919369; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 89.69677216774184m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
